Readable HTML/HTM/PDF standards documents under the primary Links and Cite-as sections of collapsed standard records. Each distinct linked document/version URL is an expected resource, including specified-version and latest-version citation aliases. Schemas, archives, editable originals, and other document formats in those sections are neutral alternatives. Committee, voting, taxonomy, and policy links are outside scope.
label_method: Prespecified listing scope and CSS selectors reviewed against saved HTML before any model evaluation; URL-level weak labels, not independent human gold.
auxiliary_scope: Non-HTML/PDF document formats under the same primary Links and Cite-as sections, such as XML schemas, ZIP distributions, DOC, DOCX, and ODT editable originals.
scope_note: 446 collapsed standards records include multiple documents, parts, formats, and version aliases. This is a URL-level resource scope, not one expected URL per standard. Malformed href values rejected by canonical URL validation are excluded.
